next_step: Kickoff POC (hosted) w/ eval set + pricing for Dedicated option
notes:
Summary: Mid-market product team building personalized product search and merchandising. They currently use Elastic for retrieval + in-house gradient-boosted model for ranking. Exploring Redwood to add a learned reranker endpoint (second-pass) and to reduce manual tuning.

Meeting highlights (shorthand):
- 2025-02-12 discovery call w/ AE (Maya), SE (Diego), PM (Rashmi) and Eng lead (Tom). High-level ask: better relevance w/ less ops overhead.
- 2025-02-25 demo: Hosted API demo focused on reranking endpoint, score-only responses, and batch offline scoring. Customer liked score-only latency estimates.
- 2025-03-01 security sync: provided SOC2 docs, asked about KMS and audit logging.

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Workload: query time reranking (second-pass) after initial retrieval via embeddings or BM25. Candidate set size typically 10-50.
- Latency targets: p50 < 60ms for reranker score-only; p95 < 250ms on hosted; p99 must be graceful with fallback.
- Throughput: steady-state 50-120 qps, burst to 250 qps during promotions.
- Offline scoring: must support batch offline scoring jobs for nightly re-ranking and to generate training labels. Prefer an API or S3-able job output.
- Eval sets: will provide 10k labeled query-candidate pairs + business metrics (click-through, purchase). Need tooling to run experiments and compare A/B and offline metrics.
- Model preferences: open to base LLM-based reranker; want control over model variant and quantization tradeoffs. Need ability to pin model version for repeatability.
- Routing/fallback: want preference to route to Hosted -> Dedicated during scale or for data isolation. Automatic fallback to smaller model acceptable during capacity issues.

Cost sensitivity: finance flagged annual spend bands; prefer hosted for quick start but want pricing for Dedicated reserved pool if unit cost improvement >25% and SLA benefits.

Quotes/assorted notes: "We want the re-ranker to be a drop-in second-pass — minimal infra changes" (Tom, Eng). "Need to see offline scoring output format before POC" (Rashmi, PM).

POC plan (agreed):
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): Hosted API POC with a supplied eval set. Run offline scoring and live scoring on sample traffic. Redwood to supply example scoring pipeline and cost estimates.
- Phase 2 (3-4 weeks): Full evaluation with larger eval set + latency profiling. If unit cost / latency meets targets, finance will evaluate Dedicated pricing.

Questions asked by customer:
- Can reranking endpoint return score-only (no tokens) and a deterministic score for offline reproducibility?
- Does Redwood support bulk/offline scoring jobs and S3 pushback?
- How are model rollouts handled (can we pin and promote)?
- Data residency options for EU customers (some merchants require EU-only storage).

Open items / follow-ups:
- Send Hosted POC credentials and a sample scoring pipeline (action: Maya, ETA 2025-03-05).
- Provide Dedicated pricing tiers and committed throughput options (action: Sales Ops).
- SE to validate p95 estimates on comparable workloads and share perf profiles (action: Diego).

Internal next steps (Redwood):
- Prepare hosted POC quota and example S3 batch scoring job.
- Draft Dedicated pricing scenarios tied to 12/24 month commits.
- Coordinate with Security team on KMS/contract language for data residency.
